title: How Telegram shares revenue and builds on blockchain: Durov's TOKEN2049 keynote
summary: Durov explains Telegram's creator-first model: contextual ads with no personal-data targeting, 50% ad revenue sharing, free tools for merchants, and blockchain-based payments and tokenized usernames. He argues platform success belongs to creators and developers, so the platform should give back and keep rules fair for everyone.

principles.text: Monetize with contextual ads, not personal data, and keep the creator-to-user link free of algorithmic feeds.
principles.quote: we don't use your personal data to Target ads we don't sell your personal data to advertisers all our ads are context based

principles.text: Platform success comes from creators and developers, so give back to them.
principles.quote: we understand that all our success all our popularity is because of you

principles.text: Share half of ad proceeds with creators, even when it isn't the commercially optimal move.
principles.quote: 50% of all the proceeds that we receive from displaying ads in Broad channels goes to the owners of such channels

principles.text: Give third-party developers and merchants freedom and free tools to build on your platform.
principles.quote: we strongly believe in giving people freedom to build their own tools their own apps their own businesses on Telegram

principles.text: Tokenize assets deeply embedded in daily user behavior so they have real utility and spread virally.
principles.quote: we believe in socially relevant nfts we believe in nfts that are deeply integrated into human culture into human interaction into our communication

principles.text: Pick infrastructure that can handle your scale of transactions.
principles.quote: at our scale we need something that can process tens of millions potentially hundreds of millions of transactions
